articles.summary: CARSON CITY, Nev., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (" BioVie " or the " Company "), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced that it has entered into a securities purchase agreement with a single healthcare focused institutional investor for the purchase and sale of 2,962,500 shares of common stock (or common stock equivalents in lieu thereof) at a purchase price of $1.60 per share in a registered direct offering priced at-the-market under Nasdaq rules. In addition, in a concurrent private placement, the Company will issue and sell unregistered common warrants to purchase up to 2,962,500 shares of common stock (together with the registered direct offering, the “ Offering ”). articles.summary: New findings from the Phase 2 ADDRESS-LC trial suggest two distinct biomarker-defined Long COVID endotypes 1 associated with different patient responses to bezisterim treatment. Patients with a high-inflammatory endotype showed improvements in objective cognitive impairment, while those with a low-myeloid endotype experienced improvements in fatigue and post-exertional malaise. CARSON CITY, Nev., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (“BioVie” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced new biomarker findings from the ADDRESS-LC trial of bezisterim were presented at the 2026 RECOVER–Treating Long COVID (RECOVER-TLC) Hybrid Workshop. The workshop was hosted by the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) and the Foundation for the National Institutes of Health (FNIH) from November 4–5, 2026, in Bethesda, Maryland. articles.summary: CARSON CITY, Nev., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (“BioVie” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced the Company has been invited to present a late-breaking oral presentation at the 4th Long COVID International Conference 2026 to be held in Nice, France from November 12-13, 2026. Dr. Penelope Markham, BioVie’s Senior Vice President and Program Lead for Long COVID, will share the presentation titled “Bezisterim Improves Fatigue, Post-Exertional Malaise, and Cognition in Prespecified High-Symptom-Burden Subgroups of the Phase 2 Randomized ADDRESS-LC Trial in Long COVID” during the “Session 8: Clinical Trials” session, starting 3:30 p.m. on Friday, November 13.
